technical-summary: Restored the independent attention-prefill off, QK, PV and combined modes for historical Qwen35 H256/GQA6/page16 native E4M3, fp8_v4 and k6_v4 cache rows. The 24 edits applied and reapplied byte-identically on frozen upstream 3deabdaeca17b58bad90d332f4b204cf7bb8a10e and the preceding candidate packages. Tightened the config insertion anchor to the typed option-catalog row. Focused Release host checks covered CLI, YAML and the supported architecture mode/cache matrix. The combined package and registry suite passed 57 tests, and selected gfx1201 attention and registry objects compiled. The prefill rows keep the v1.17.0 19d4e8fe0e18071b9b6300f15fc4ccf38dc4fa3d compute behavior and opt-in semantics. Integrated new-base serving and recipe promotion remain pending.
